explanation: Both products exceed 5, so the shape is close to normal.

question_text: Calculate the magnitude of the vector (6; 8).
explanation: The magnitude of (x; y) is √(x² + y²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10. Adding the components, 6 + 8 = 14, is not the magnitude, so use the formula.

question_text: Increasing the sample rate of a sound recording does what?
options: Takes more samples each second, so the file grows and quality improves
Adds more bits to each sample
Removes background noise from the recording
explanation: Sample rate is samples per second: more of them follows the wave better and stores more data. Bits per sample is the separate resolution setting; noise removal is filtering, not sampling.

question_text: A 0.5 kg ball moves in a circle of radius 2 m at 6 m/s. Find the centripetal force.
explanation: F = m v^2 / r = 0.5 x 36 / 2 = 9 N, directed towards the centre.

question_text: A racemic mixture is:
explanation: Equal amounts of both enantiomers cancel out the rotation of plane-polarised light.

question_text: Solve |x + 3| < 7, giving an inequality.
explanation: -7 < x + 3 < 7 [1]. Subtract 3: -10 < x < 4 [1]. One-sided answers miss the negative branch.
P(X ≥ 1) = 1 − P(X = 0) = 1 − (0.5)⁸ = 1 − 1/256 ≈ 0.9961. Working from the complement avoids adding up the eight separate terms.

question_text: What is a homologous series?
options: A family of compounds with the same functional group and similar chemistry
explanation: Members share a functional group and general formula, differ by CH2, and show a gradation in physical properties.

question_text: Two identical lamps are connected in parallel across a 6 V battery. What voltage is across each lamp?
explanation: Parallel branches each see the full supply voltage of 6 V.

question_text: The radius of a charge's circular path is:
explanation:
M1: equate magnetic force to centripetal force BQv = mv²/r
A1: r = mv/(BQ)

question_text: A bag has 2 red and 3 green balls. Two balls are drawn WITHOUT replacement. What is P(both red)?
£2000 at 4% compound interest for 3 years. What is the total amount?
explanation: \(2000 \times 1.04^3 = 2249.73\). £2240 is the simple total; £2480 doubles the rate effect; £2000 ignores interest.

question_text: Which definition describes the standard enthalpy of combustion?
options: The enthalpy change when one mole of a substance burns completely in oxygen under standard conditions
The enthalpy change when one mole of bonds is broken
The enthalpy change when an acid is neutralised by an alkali
The enthalpy change when one mole of a compound forms from its elements
explanation: Standard enthalpy of combustion refers to one mole of a substance burnt completely in oxygen.

question_text: Emission spectra lines correspond to:
explanation: B1: lines correspond to photon emission when electrons fall from higher to lower energy levels; ΔE = hf

question_text: What happens if a summary is written as bullet points?
explanation: Bullets may convey content, but continuous prose is required for the expression/style credit.

question_text: 4x/(x² − 1) in partial fractions is:
explanation: Write 4x / ((x - 1)(x + 1)) = A/(x - 1) + B/(x + 1). Then A(x + 1) + B(x - 1) = 4x gives A + B = 4 and A - B = 0, so A = B = 2.

question_text: Which reagent oxidises ethanol to ethanal when the product is distilled off?
explanation: Distilling off the aldehyde prevents it being oxidised further to ethanoic acid.

question_text: XOR gate output when A=1, B=1:
explanation: An XOR gate outputs 1 only when its inputs differ and 0 when they are the same. With A = 1 and B = 1 the inputs are the same, so the output is 0. An OR gate would give 1 here.

question_text: Which radiation is stopped by a sheet of paper?
explanation: Alpha is the least penetrating and is absorbed by paper.

question_text: Full-duplex means:
explanation: A full-duplex channel transmits and receives at the same time. Half-duplex allows both directions, but only one at a time.

question_text: Which fraction of crude oil has the highest boiling point?
explanation: Bitumen contains the longest chains and therefore has the highest boiling point.

question_text: Binding energy per nucleon peaks near:
explanation: B1: binding energy per nucleon peaks at iron (≈ 56Fe); fusion below, fission above iron

question_text: Why are viruses not placed in any of the five kingdoms?
options: They are too small to see
They are not made of cells and cannot reproduce without a host cell
explanation: A virus is a nucleic acid inside a protein coat. It has no cell structure and no metabolism of its own, so it is not considered a living organism by the five-kingdom model.

question_text: A force of 20 N acts 0.50 m from a pivot at right angles. The moment is
explanation: Moment = force x perpendicular distance = 20 x 0.50 = 10 N m. [M1][A1]

question_text: y = f(x − 2) transforms the graph by:
explanation: Replacing x with x − 2 in f(x) shifts the graph 2 units to the right. A shift of x + 2 would move it to the left. The transformation acts on the x-values, not the y-values.

question_text: Where is the kinetic energy of a body in simple harmonic motion greatest?
options: At the extremes, where the displacement is greatest
explanation: Speed is greatest at equilibrium, so kinetic energy is greatest there. At the extremes the speed is zero and all the energy is potential.

question_text: Which cell-surface molecules on the outer face of the membrane act as recognition sites?
explanation: Glycoproteins and glycolipids on the outer surface help cells recognise each other.

question_text: W follows B(12, 0.4). Find P(W >= 2) via the complement.
explanation: P(0) = 0.6 to the 12th = 0.0022 [1]. P(1) = 12 x 0.4 x 0.6 to the 11th = 0.0174 [1]. P(>=2) = 1 - 0.0022 - 0.0174 = 0.9804. Summing twelve terms directly wastes the complement shortcut.

question_text: In a histogram, what does the y-axis represent?
explanation: In a histogram, the y-axis is frequency density = frequency ÷ class width. Area = frequency.

question_text: A truth table is 1 only for A=0,B=1 and A=1,B=0. Which expression matches?
explanation: The first true row contributes A'B and the second AB'. OR the minterms: A'B + AB'. This is XOR because the inputs differ; the other rows are both 0.

question_text: In a proton NMR spectrum, what does the number of peaks indicate?
explanation: Each chemically distinct set of hydrogens gives a separate peak.

question_text: What colour does a positive biuret test give?
explanation: Biuret reagent (Cu2+ in alkali) turns violet in the presence of peptide bonds.

question_text: Which gas is produced at the anode when dilute sulfuric acid is electrolysed?
explanation: Hydroxide ions are oxidised to oxygen at the anode.

question_text: Short tandem repeats (STRs) are used in forensics because:
options: all people have the same number of repeats
the number of repeats varies between individuals
they are found only in mitochondria
explanation: STRs vary in copy number between people, giving a DNA profile.

question_text: Which best explains diffusion of gases?
options: Random motion of particles spreads them from high to low concentration
explanation: Diffusion is the net spreading of particles by their random motion.

question_text: A counter-argument paragraph helps because it:
options: Shows awareness of opposing views and allows the writer to rebut them
Weakens the writer's case by definition
explanation: Acknowledging and answering the opposing view makes the argument more credible.

question_text: Germinating seeds in a sealed flask warm the flask. Explain why.
options: They respire, and respiration is exothermic, so some energy is released as heat
They are absorbing heat from the room
explanation: Respiration transfers chemical energy to ATP and heat, which raises the temperature of the flask.

question_text: What effect does a catalyst have on the equilibrium yield?
options: None; it only speeds up attainment of equilibrium
explanation: A catalyst speeds both directions equally, so the equilibrium position is unchanged.

question_text: Melting 0.2 kg ice (L = 334 kJ/kg) takes about:
explanation: The energy to melt ice is Q = mL, where L is the specific latent heat of fusion. Q = 0.2 kg × 334 000 J kg⁻¹ = 66 800 J, which is about 67 kJ. Latent heat is used during a change of state, so the temperature stays constant.

question_text: Data: 2, 4, 6, 8. What is the population standard deviation?
explanation: The mean is 5 and the squared deviations sum to 20, so the variance is 20/4 = 5 and the standard deviation is sqrt(5) = 2.236.

question_text: 100W for 3 hours. Energy?
explanation: Energy = power × time = 0.1 kW × 3 h = 0.3 kWh (use kW and hours to get kWh).

question_text: PROCEDURE AddBonus(Salary) adds 100 to Salary and prints it. CALL AddBonus(500) outputs what?
explanation: 500 arrives as Salary, 100 is added, 600 prints. Procedures output freely (they just return nothing); 500 ignores the addition; 0 invents a value.

question_text: Find the equation of the line through (1, 2) and (5, 10).
explanation: Gradient = (10-2)/(5-1) = 2 [1]. Through (1,2): y - 2 = 2(x - 1), so y = 2x [1]. The zero intercept must still be checked, not assumed.

question_text: A ball is thrown vertically upwards at 12 m s⁻¹. Taking g = 9.81 m s⁻², what maximum height does it reach above the release point?
explanation: At the top v = 0. Using v² = u² + 2as: 0 = 12² + 2(−9.81)s, so s = 144 / 19.62 ≈ 7.3 m. The equation without t avoids finding the time.

question_text: Simplify root 50, giving your answer in the form a root b with b prime.
explanation: Split: root 50 = root(25 x 2) = 5 root 2 [1]. Since 2 is prime the surd is fully simplified [1]. 25 root 2 fails to take the square root of 25.

question_text: Averages of n=25 samples from mean 100, sd 15. State the sampling distribution of the mean.
explanation: Mean stays 100 [1]. Variance 225/25 = 9 (sd 3) by the CLT structure [1]. Dividing the mean by n as well collapses everything.

question_text: The salt formed when an amine reacts with HCl is:
explanation: An amine is a base, so it accepts a proton from HCl and forms an alkylammonium salt, for example CH₃NH₃⁺Cl⁻. The product is a salt, not an ester, an amide or an alkyl chloride, which would need different reactants.

question_text: Write SQL to add column Email TEXT(50) to Table Customer, and state its class.
options: ALTER TABLE Customer ADD Email TEXT(50); (DDL)
explanation: ALTER TABLE changes structure, so DDL [1]. ADD with the full field definition appends the column [1]. UPDATE/INSERT alter rows (DML), not structure.

question_text: Which is a 'show, don't tell' version of "She was angry"?
options: Her jaw tightened and she slammed the cupboard door
explanation: The option about the jaw and the cupboard door shows the anger through physical action. The others name it or intensify the name.

question_text: Absolute zero =
explanation: Absolute zero is 0 K = −273 °C, the temperature at which particles have the least possible kinetic energy.

question_text: A stationary wave:
explanation: B1: stationary wave stores (does not transfer) energy; energy is trapped in the loops

question_text: What bond must be present in a molecule for hydrogen bonding to occur?
options: H bonded to N, O or F
explanation: The H must be bonded to a very electronegative atom (N, O or F) to form a hydrogen bond.

question_text: The significance level α is the probability of:
options: rejecting H₀ when it is true
explanation: The significance level α is the probability of a Type I error: rejecting H₀ when H₀ is actually true. It is chosen before the test is carried out. A Type II error is accepting H₀ when H₁ is true.

question_text: Why is zinc not classed as a transition metal?
options: It has no unpaired electrons in the atom
It is not a d-block element
Zn2+ has a completely filled d subshell
explanation: Zn2+ is d10, so it fails the incomplete-d-subshell criterion despite being in the d-block.

question_text: What is the effect of tar in cigarette smoke?
options: It paralyses cilia and contains carcinogens, so mucus and pathogens accumulate and cancer risk rises
explanation: Tar destroys the cleaning mechanism and mutates cells, leading to smoker's cough, bronchitis and lung cancer.

question_text: Evaluate (3; -2) + (-5; 7) as a single column vector.
explanation: Add x-components: 3 + (-5) = -2 [1]. Add y-components: -2 + 7 = 5 [1]. Result (-2; 5). Mixing signs in the y-component gives 9.

question_text: 'While I ___ dinner, the phone rang.'
explanation: A longer background action (past continuous) was interrupted by a shorter completed event (past simple).

question_text: Heroin is classified as
options: A depressant that relieves pain and causes addiction
explanation: Heroin is a strong analgesic that depresses the nervous system and is highly addictive.

question_text: The line through (1, 2) and (5, 10) is:
explanation: The gradient is m = (10 − 2)/(5 − 1) = 8/4 = 2. Using y − 2 = 2(x − 1) gives y = 2x. Check: (5, 10) gives 2 × 5 = 10, and (1, 2) gives 2 × 1 = 2, as required.

question_text: Which metal is extracted by heating its oxide with carbon?
explanation: Metals below carbon in the series can be reduced by carbon.

question_text: The sum of the first 20 terms with a = 2, d = 3 is:
explanation: The sum of an AP is Sₙ = n/2 × (2a + (n − 1)d). With n = 20, a = 2 and d = 3: S₂₀ = 10 × (4 + 57) = 610. The 600 option is close but is not the exact sum.

question_text: An advantage of open source software is:
explanation: Open source allows anyone to view, modify, and redistribute the code.

question_text: P(not A) = 0.35. What is P(A)?
explanation: Probabilities of complementary events add to 1, so P(A) = 1 − P(not A) = 1 − 0.35 = 0.65. The given 0.35 is P(not A), not P(A), so it cannot be the answer.

question_text: What is phenol's systematic name?
explanation: Phenol is hydroxybenzene; the -OH directly bonded to the ring greatly changes its chemistry vs alcohols.

question_text: Coding y = (x − 10)/2 gives ȳ = 4. Then x̄ =
explanation: From y = (x − 10)/2 we get x = 2y + 10. The mean transforms in the same way, so x̄ = 2ȳ + 10 = 2 × 4 + 10 = 18.

question_text: A 0.50 kg trolley moving at 4.0 m s⁻¹ collides with and sticks to a stationary 1.0 kg trolley. What is their common velocity after the collision?
explanation: Momentum is conserved: 0.50 × 4.0 = (0.50 + 1.0) v, so v = 2.0 / 1.5 ≈ 1.3 m s⁻¹.

question_text: A farmer ploughs a field and removes all the hedges. Predict two effects on the ecosystem.
options: Habitat and food sources are lost, so biodiversity falls; without hedges, soil erosion and pest build-up may increase
explanation: Removing habitat reduces niches and disrupts food webs, making the system less stable.

question_text: Which field makes the best primary key for a MEMBERS table?
explanation: MemberID is unique by design. Surnames, towns and ages all repeat across real members, so each fails the duplicate test.

question_text: A correlation coefficient r = -0.9 is calculated. Which conclusion is correct?
explanation: r close to -1 indicates a strong negative linear correlation. Correlation never implies causation.

question_text: Which chamber of the heart pumps blood to the lungs?
explanation: The right ventricle pumps deoxygenated blood along the pulmonary artery to the lungs.

question_text: σ = 12, n = 36. The standard error of x̄ is:
explanation: The standard error of the sample mean is σ/√n = 12/√36 = 12/6 = 2. The 0.33 option is σ/n, which divides by n rather than √n.

question_text: Why does solid sodium chloride not conduct electricity?
options: Its ions are fixed in the lattice
Its electrons are localised on atoms
explanation: Ions are held in place in the lattice; they become mobile only when molten or dissolved.

question_text: What is batch culture?
options: Microorganisms grown in a fixed volume of medium without fresh nutrients
explanation: Batch culture shows the full growth curve but nutrients decline and waste accumulates.

question_text: Why does hydrogen fluoride have a higher boiling point than hydrogen chloride?
explanation: Hydrogen bonding in HF is stronger than the dipole forces in HCl.

question_text: What does \(A \cup B\) contain?
options: Elements in both A and B
Elements in A but not in B
Elements in A or B or both
explanation: Union gathers either-or-and-both. Both-only is intersection; A-not-B is difference; outside-everything is the complement of the union.

question_text: A coin is spun 200 times, landing heads 88 times. What is the relative frequency of heads?
explanation: 88/200 = 0.44. 88 is the raw count; 0.56 counts tails; 1/2 is theory, not experiment.

question_text: Which infrared absorption confirms the presence of an alcohol group?
explanation: The O-H stretch of an alcohol is broad and strong around 3200-3600 cm^-1 (carbonyl C=O sits near 1720).

question_text: What is drug tolerance?
options: The need for a larger dose to produce the same effect
explanation: Repeated use changes receptors, so the original dose no longer gives the same response.

question_text: What is the main advantage of an electromagnet over a permanent magnet?
options: It can be switched on and off by the current
explanation: An electromagnet's field exists only while current flows, so it can be switched on and off.

question_text: 18 electrons, 20 neutrons and 19 protons describes
explanation: The proton number 19 identifies potassium, and 19 + 20 = 39 is the mass number.

question_text: What is the complex conjugate of 2 - 5i?
explanation: The complex conjugate changes the sign of the imaginary part, giving 2 + 5i.

question_text: A vernier caliper has a main scale reading of 2.4 cm and the sixth vernier division coincides. The reading is
explanation: Each vernier division is 0.1 mm, so six divisions add 0.06 cm to give 2.46 cm. [A1]

question_text: Ethanol can be produced by
options: Fermentation of glucose or hydration of ethene
explanation: Fermentation is the biological route and hydration the industrial one.

question_text: Sector area with r = 5, θ = 1.2 rad:
explanation: Sector area is A = ½r²θ with θ in radians. Here A = ½ × 5² × 1.2 = ½ × 25 × 1.2 = 15. The 30 option forgets the one-half.

question_text: Why does the blood in the renal artery contain more urea than blood in the renal vein?
options: Urea is filtered from the blood into the nephron and excreted, so less leaves than enters
explanation: Filtration removes urea from the blood, so the renal vein carries less than the renal artery.

question_text: A letter is picked at random from the word BANANA. Find the probability it is the letter A.
explanation: Marks as awarded: A appears 3 times of 6 letters [1]; 3/6 = 1/2 [1]. 1/3 counts distinct letters instead.

question_text: What is the equation of a line through (2, 1) with gradient 4?
explanation: Use y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) with m = 4 and the point (2, 1): y − 1 = 4(x − 2), so y = 4x − 8 + 1 = 4x − 7. Check: at x = 2, y = 8 − 7 = 1, as required.

question_text: An ethical issue with AI is:
explanation: A key ethical concern with AI is algorithmic bias. A model trained on biased or unrepresentative data reproduces and can amplify those biases in its outcomes, which can treat people unfairly. Power use and speed are technical issues rather than ethical ones.

question_text: A hydrocarbon contains
explanation: By definition, no other element is present.

question_text: A circuit outputs (A NOR B) AND (A XOR B). What is the full output column for rows 00, 01, 10, 11?
explanation: NOR gives 1,0,0,0 and XOR gives 0,1,1,0; ANDing them gives 0,0,0,0 — the two can never be 1 together. The middle options each copy one gate's column instead of combining.

question_text: In which state are particles closely packed in a regular arrangement?
explanation: Solids have a fixed lattice with particles vibrating about fixed positions.

question_text: Find the largest integer satisfying 4(x - 2) < 3x + 1.
explanation: Expand: 4x - 8 < 3x + 1 [1]. Rearrange: x < 9, so the largest integer is 8 [1]. Writing x <= 9 or answering 9 confuses the strict inequality with the integer below it.

question_text: What does stepping through code in a debugger do?
options: Runs the program one line at a time so values can be checked
Deletes each line after running it
explanation: Stepping executes line by line under inspection — the definition of the technique. It deletes, rewrites and accelerates nothing.

question_text: The function f(x) = x^3 - x - 1 has a root in which interval?
explanation: f(1) = -1 and f(2) = 5, so a sign change brackets a root in (1, 2).

question_text: Which operation set defines the queue ADT?
options: Enqueue and dequeue with FIFO discipline
explanation: Queues add at the rear (enqueue) and remove from the front (dequeue) [1]. FIFO order is part of the definition, not an implementation detail [1]. Push/pop define stacks.

question_text: JOIN is used to:
explanation: A JOIN combines rows from two or more tables where the key values match, which links related data across the tables. Sorting uses ORDER BY and filtering uses WHERE.

question_text: Why do simple molecular substances have low boiling points?
options: The forces between molecules are weak, so little energy is needed to separate them
explanation: Intermolecular forces are overcome on boiling; the covalent bonds within molecules stay intact.

question_text: Above the optimum temperature an enzyme is
options: Denatured, because the active site changes shape
explanation: High temperature breaks the bonds holding the tertiary structure, so the active site no longer fits the substrate.

question_text: ∫ x e^x dx =
explanation: Integrate by parts with u = x and dv = e^x dx, so ∫x e^x dx = x e^x − ∫e^x dx = x e^x − e^x + c. Differentiating the answer confirms it.

question_text: Which is the best opening for a formal letter to a recipient whose name you do not know?
explanation: Dear Sir or Madam is the standard formal opening when the name is unknown.

question_text: Describe how to prepare pure, dry crystals of copper(II) sulfate from copper(II) oxide and dilute sulfuric acid.
options: Warm the acid, add the oxide until excess remains, filter, evaporate the filtrate to the point of crystallisation, then cool and dry the crystals
explanation: The excess oxide ensures all the acid is used, and slow evaporation gives crystals.

question_text: A plane flies 200 km on bearing 090°, then 150 km on bearing 180°. How far south of the start is it?
explanation: Marks as awarded: east leg contributes no southing [1]; south leg gives 150 km [1]. 350 totals blindly; 200 quotes the east leg; 50 subtracts the legs.

question_text: Compare a wind turbine and a coal-fired power station as sources of electrical energy, giving one advantage and one disadvantage of each.
options: Wind is renewable with no fuel cost but is intermittent and needs many turbines; coal is reliable and can be scaled but is non-renewable and releases carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide
explanation: Two points per resource, each tied to a real property. [B1][B1][B1][B1]

question_text: A speed-time graph shows a horizontal line at 20 m/s. What does this mean?
explanation: A horizontal line on a speed-time graph means speed is not changing: constant speed.

question_text: Why do most leaves have stomata mainly on the lower surface?
options: To reduce water loss, because the lower surface is shaded and cooler, while still allowing gas exchange
explanation: Fewer stomata on the upper surface limits evaporation from the sunlit side while gas exchange continues underneath.

question_text: Why does an atom produce a line spectrum rather than a continuous spectrum?
options: Electrons can take any energy, but only at high temperatures
Photons are absorbed in a continuous range of energies
Electrons can only occupy discrete energy levels, so only photons of specific energies are emitted or absorbed
The nucleus emits photons of fixed wavelength
explanation: Only specific energy differences between the discrete levels are possible, so only photons of those energies are emitted or absorbed, giving sharp lines.

question_text: Which condition increases the rate of transpiration?
explanation: Dry moving air removes water vapour from around the leaf, keeping a steep diffusion gradient.

question_text: What is the purpose of a secondary key, with an example?
options: Uniquely identifies rows, e.g. passport number
Speeds searching on a non-primary field, e.g. indexing Surname
explanation: A secondary key (index) speeds queries on fields that are searched often [1]. Surname indexed finds names fast without being the primary key [1]. It neither enforces uniqueness nor encrypts.

question_text: In the balanced equation C3H8 + ? O2 → 3CO2 + 4H2O, what is the coefficient of O2?
explanation: Oxygen atoms on the right: 6 + 4 = 10, so 5 O2 molecules are needed.

question_text: Which sentence uses personification?
options: 'She is as tall as a tree'
explanation: 'Knocked' gives opportunity a human action — personification.

question_text: A 2 kg object moves at 3 m/s. What is its kinetic energy?
explanation: Ek = ½mv² = ½ × 2 kg × (3 m/s)² = ½ × 2 × 9 = 9 J. The speed is squared, so 9 J, not 3 J or 6 J.

question_text: Which memory comparison is correct?
options: PROM is electrically rewritten in-circuit; EEPROM is one-time programmable
EPROM uses periodic refresh; DRAM is non-volatile
PROM is programmed once; EEPROM can be electrically erased and rewritten
SRAM is secondary storage; ROM is volatile
explanation: PROM cannot be erased after one-time programming, whereas EEPROM supports electrical erasure and reprogramming. DRAM refresh and SRAM/ROM volatility are separate distinctions; the alternatives mix unrelated properties.

question_text: Which word means 'able to be read'?
explanation: -able means able to be, so readable means able to be read.

question_text: In DNA, adenine pairs with:
explanation: In DNA, adenine (A) pairs with thymine (T), joined by two hydrogen bonds, and guanine pairs with cytosine. Uracil replaces thymine only in RNA.

question_text: What happens when two like magnetic poles are brought together?
explanation: Like magnetic poles repel and unlike poles attract. Bringing two like poles together does not make them neutral or cancel their effect.

question_text: Three angles on a straight line are (2x + 10) degrees, (x + 20) degrees and 90 degrees. Find x and hence the largest of the three angles.
explanation: Angles on a straight line sum to 180: (2x + 10) + (x + 20) + 90 = 180 [1]. So 3x + 120 = 180 and x = 20; the angles are 50, 40 and 90, so the largest is 90 [1]. Collecting the constants wrongly is where the mark is lost.

question_text: If X ~ B(5, 0.4), what is Var(X)?
explanation: Var(X) = np(1 - p) = 5 x 0.4 x 0.6 = 1.2. The mean np = 2.0 is a different quantity and is not the variance.

question_text: Explain why a reaction with a high activation energy may not appear to happen at room temperature.
options: Few collisions have enough energy to overcome the barrier, so the rate is negligible until the mixture is heated
explanation: Only the fraction of collisions above the barrier reacts, and that fraction is tiny when the barrier is high.

question_text: DECLARE Team : ARRAY[1:11] OF STRING holds footballers. Which index holds the last player?
explanation: Bounds 1:11 make Team[11] the last slot. 0478 arrays start at 1 (no Team[0]); 10 is second-last; 12 is out of bounds.

question_text: A student tests an unknown solution: Benedict's stays blue after heating, iodine stays brown, Biuret turns violet. Name the nutrient present and one nutrient definitely absent.
options: Protein is present; reducing sugar and starch are absent
explanation: Only the Biuret test changed, so protein is present; the negative Benedict's and iodine results rule out reducing sugar and starch.

question_text: What is the binary representation of the decimal number 10?
explanation: The binary representation of 10 is 1010 because 8+2=10, and the binary place values are 8, 4, 2, and 1.

question_text: Which factor is abiotic?
explanation: Abiotic factors are physical and chemical, such as temperature, light, pH and water.

question_text: Evaluate the definite integral from 1 to 3 of (2x + 1).
explanation: Antiderivative x squared + x [1]. (9 + 3) - (1 + 1) = 12 - 2 = 10 [1]. Subtracting the lower limit the wrong way round flips the sign.

question_text: Longitudinal waves oscillate:
explanation: In a longitudinal wave, particles oscillate parallel to the direction the wave travels, creating compressions and rarefactions. Sound in air is the standard example. Transverse waves are the ones that oscillate perpendicular to travel.

question_text: The gradient of y = x² at x = 3 is:
explanation: The derivative of x² is 2x, so the gradient at x = 3 is 2 × 3 = 6. The 9 option is x² at x = 3, which is a height on the curve, not a gradient.

question_text: A protocol is best described as:
explanation: A protocol is a set of agreed rules that govern how devices format, send and receive data. It is not a cable, a network topology or an operating system.

question_text: The time constant of 100 kΩ with 500 μF is:
explanation: The time constant is τ = RC. With R = 100 kΩ = 1.0 × 10⁵ Ω and C = 500 μF = 5.0 × 10⁻⁴ F, τ = 1.0 × 10⁵ × 5.0 × 10⁻⁴ = 50 s. Convert the prefixes first, because kΩ and μF are not base units.

question_text: Which is an advantage of biological control over pesticides?
options: It targets the pest and avoids chemical pollution, though the control agent may itself become a problem
explanation: Specificity reduces non-target damage and chemical residues, but the agent must be chosen carefully.

question_text: Text files must use:
explanation: Text must be stored exactly, because a single changed character alters the meaning. Lossless compression keeps every bit, so it is the only safe choice for text.

question_text: The statement 'n^2 + n + 17 is prime for all positive integers n' is false. Which counter-example disproves it?
explanation: For n = 16: 16^2 + 16 + 17 = 256 + 16 + 17 = 289 = 17^2, which is not prime. One counter-example is enough to disprove a universal claim (n = 3, 5, 7 all give primes: 29, 47, 73).

question_text: Which equation represents aerobic respiration?
explanation: Glucose is fully oxidised to carbon dioxide and water, releasing about 30-32 ATP per glucose molecule.

question_text: Explain why a plant cell does not burst when placed in pure water.
options: Water cannot enter a plant cell
Its membrane is impermeable to water
The cellulose cell wall exerts an inward pressure that balances the water entering, so the cell becomes turgid but intact
explanation: As water enters, turgor pressure rises until it equals the water potential difference, and the strong cellulose wall resists further expansion.

question_text: Explain how CSS is used to separate presentation from structure in a web page. Provide an example of how CSS can be used to change the layout of a web page.
options: CSS is used to separate presentation from structure by using a separate stylesheet
CSS is used to separate presentation from structure by using a combination of inline styles and a separate stylesheet
CSS is used to separate presentation from structure by using a separate stylesheet and JavaScript
CSS is used to separate presentation from structure by using inline styles
explanation: CSS is used to separate presentation from structure by using a separate stylesheet.

question_text: Which process requires energy from ATP?
explanation: Active transport moves substances against a gradient using ATP.

question_text: A key limitation of every simulation is:
options: it is only as accurate as its model
it cannot run in real time
explanation: B1: a simulation outputs only what its model encodes — missing modelled effects = wrong results

question_text: A writer describes a politician's promise as 'a shiny coin with no currency'. What is the effect?
options: It implies the promise is attractive but worthless
explanation: The metaphor implies superficial attractiveness with no real value — implied criticism.

question_text: A triangle has base 9 cm and vertical height 7 cm. Find its area.
explanation: \(\frac{1}{2} \times 9 \times 7 = 31.5\). 63 is the unhalved rectangle; 16 adds; 30 rounds wrongly.

question_text: Describe how the structure of a nerve cell is adapted to its function.
options: It is spherical with many chloroplasts
It has a long thin fibre that carries electrical impulses over long distances, with branching ends to connect to other cells
explanation: A long axon conducts impulses quickly between distant parts of the body, and dendrites form junctions with many other cells.

question_text: Which is an adaptation of an alveolus?
explanation: A single-cell wall gives the shortest diffusion distance for oxygen and carbon dioxide.

question_text: A pie-chart sector is 90°. What fraction of the whole is it?
explanation: \(\frac{90}{360} = \frac{1}{4}\). The others mis-divide the full turn.

question_text: A spot travels 3.0 cm while the solvent front travels 6.0 cm. The Rf value is
explanation: Rf = distance moved by the spot divided by distance moved by the solvent front = 3.0/6.0.

question_text: Which nutrient deficiency causes rickets?
explanation: Without vitamin D, calcium and phosphate are poorly absorbed, so bones soften and bend.

question_text: Which sentence is more formal?
options: We are unable to attend the meeting tomorrow.
explanation: The sentence with we are unable avoids contractions and casual phrases and uses precise vocabulary.

question_text: 'He's famous ___ his generosity.'
explanation: 'Famous for' introduces the reason someone is known, here his generosity. 'Famous by' and 'famous with' are not the standard collocations.

question_text: Which of these would lose marks in a summary?
options: Including material outside the specified focus
explanation: Material outside the question's focus is irrelevant and wastes the word limit; content marks come only from the asked-for aspect.

question_text: In mammalian muscle without enough oxygen, pyruvate is converted to:
explanation: Lactate is formed, which regenerates NAD so glycolysis can continue.

question_text: Evaluate (72 - 8 x 5) + 4 squared, showing the correct order of operations.
explanation: Brackets and multiplication first: 8 x 5 = 40, so 72 - 40 = 32; 4 squared = 16 [1]. Then 32 + 16 = 48 [1]. Working left to right ((72 - 8) x 5) breaks BIDMAS and gives 320-scale answers.

question_text: A farmer grows a GM maize that produces its own insecticide. Give one advantage and one possible disadvantage.
options: Advantage: fewer insecticide sprays and higher yield; disadvantage: non-target insects may be harmed and resistant pests may evolve
explanation: The saving in chemicals is real, but ecological effects and resistance must be managed.

question_text: Triangle ABC ~ Triangle DEF. AB = 5, DE = 15, BC = 8. What is EF?
explanation: Similar triangles scale every side by the same factor: DE / AB = 15 / 5 = 3. So EF = BC x 3 = 8 x 3 = 24. The 12 option divides instead of multiplying, which reverses the scale factor.

question_text: Rationalise the denominator of 6 / root 3, simplifying fully.
explanation: Multiply top and bottom by root 3: 6 root 3 / 3 [1]. Simplify: 2 root 3 [1]. Stopping at 6 root 3 / 3 is not fully simplified.

question_text: Which is the molecular formula if the empirical formula is CH2 and Mr = 42?
explanation: The empirical formula mass is 14, and 42/14 = 3, so the formula is C3H6.

question_text: Which test gives a silver mirror with ethanal but not with propanone?
explanation: Aldehydes reduce Tollens' reagent to silver; ketones do not.

question_text: What is required for two sources to produce a stable interference pattern?
options: The same frequency and a constant phase difference
explanation: Interference needs coherent sources: the same frequency, and a constant phase difference between them. Coherence is what makes the pattern stable over time.

question_text: What is the oxidation number of chromium in potassium dichromate, K2Cr2O7?
explanation: Oxidation numbers sum to zero in a neutral compound. In K₂Cr₂O₇: 2(+1) + 2x + 7(−2) = 0, so 2x = 12 and x = +6. Each chromium is +6, the state that makes dichromate(VI) an oxidising agent.

question_text: A user is considering the security features of an Operating System. Which of the following is a security function of an OS?
options: Managing user permissions and access control
explanation: An OS manages user permissions and access control as a security function, while the other options are unrelated or incorrect.

question_text: The optimum pH for most human enzymes is around
explanation: Most intracellular enzymes work near neutral; pepsin in the stomach is an exception at about pH 2.

question_text: With the same bounds, what is the minimum of x − y?
explanation: Minimise by subtracting y's upper: \(3.35 - 2.5 = 0.85\). 0.95 uses x's upper; 1.85 subtracts y's lower; the negative reverses the inputs.

question_text: Which part of the leaf is the main site of evaporation?
options: The moist cell surfaces in the air spaces of the spongy mesophyll
explanation: Air spaces expose a large wet surface area from which water evaporates into the leaf's internal atmosphere.

question_text: How does a Grignard reagent extend a carbon chain?
options: RMgBr reacts with water to give an alkene
RMgBr reacts with CO2 then hydrolysis gives a carboxylic acid with one extra carbon
explanation: Carbonation of the Grignard followed by acid work-up adds exactly one carbon as -COOH.

question_text: Withdrawal symptoms occur when
options: A dependent person stops taking a drug
explanation: The body has adapted to the drug, so stopping causes physical symptoms until it adjusts.

question_text: Which two reagents reduce a nitrile to a primary amine?
options: LiAlH₄ or H₂ with a Ni catalyst
explanation: Nitriles are reduced to primary amines by LiAlH4, or by hydrogen with a nickel catalyst, turning -CN into -CH2NH2. NaBH4 alone is too weak, and dilute HCl or bromine water do not reduce nitriles.

question_text: f(x) = 2x + 1 and g(x) = x squared - 2. Find gf(3).
explanation: First apply f: f(3) = 2(3) + 1 = 7 [1]. Then apply g: g(7) = 49 - 2 = 47 [1]. Computing fg(3) = 2(7) + 1 = 15 instead reverses the order and scores nothing.

question_text: What is the value of ln 1?
explanation: ln 1 = 0 because e^0 = 1. The curve y = ln x passes through (1, 0).

question_text: Light enters glass:
explanation: Glass is optically denser, so light slows down and refracts towards the normal; on leaving it speeds up and bends away from the normal.

question_text: What is the name for the energy absorbed during a change of state at constant temperature?
explanation: Latent heat is absorbed or released during a change of state with no temperature change.

question_text: In the blast furnace, coke is used to
options: Reduce iron oxide and provide heat
explanation: Coke burns to carbon monoxide, which reduces the iron oxide.

question_text: The input 1 OR 1=1 in a login field is characteristic of:
explanation: B1: ' OR 1=1 -- closes the string and forces a tautology — classic SQL injection signature

question_text: Explain how the skin and mucous membranes prevent infection.
options: The skin is a tough physical barrier, and mucus traps pathogens while cilia and acid remove or kill them, so most pathogens never reach the blood
explanation: These are non-specific barriers: they act against any pathogen before the immune system is even involved.

question_text: For bivariate data: Sxy = 24, Sxx = 32, x-bar = 5, y-bar = 9. Find the regression line of y on x.
What is 3.14 classified as?
explanation: 3.14 = 314/100 is a rational number (can be expressed as a fraction).

question_text: A school database contains three tables, Students, Teachers, and Classes. The Students table has a foreign key that references the Teachers table, and the Classes table has a foreign key that references the Students table. What type of relationship exists between the Students and Classes tables?
explanation: The foreign key in the Classes table references the Students table, indicating a one-to-many relationship, where one student can be in many classes.

question_text: Gravitational potential is:
explanation: Gravitational potential is zero at infinity and negative everywhere in a gravitational field, because work must be done against gravity to move a mass out to infinity. It is never positive.

question_text: The AP with a = 1, d = 2 has uₙ = 21 when n =
explanation: The nth term is uₙ = a + (n − 1)d = 1 + (n − 1)2. Setting this to 21 gives 2(n − 1) = 20, so n − 1 = 10 and n = 11.

question_text: The peak voltage of a sinusoidal mains supply is 325 V. What is its root-mean-square voltage?
explanation: For a sinusoidal supply the RMS value is V_rms = V₀/√2 = 325/1.414 ≈ 230 V. The 325 V option is the peak value, not the RMS value.

question_text: Explain why the energy requirement of a 15-year-old is higher than that of a 70-year-old of the same mass.
options: Growth and a higher metabolic rate in the teenager need more energy for building tissue and activity, while the older person's lower activity and muscle mass reduce demand
explanation: Energy needs follow metabolic rate and activity; growth and exercise raise both, whereas ageing lowers them.

question_text: When a hardware interrupt occurs, which sequence describes the CPU response?
options: Finishes the current machine cycle, saves registers, runs the ISR
Restarts the fetch-execute cycle from zero
explanation: The CPU completes the current machine cycle first [1]. It saves register contents, runs the interrupt service routine, then restores and resumes [1]. Interrupts are never simply ignored.

question_text: Suggest two ways a farmer could reduce the environmental impact of pest control.
options: Use biological control or selective pesticides, and rotate crops or introduce natural predators so fewer chemicals are needed
explanation: Reducing broad chemicals and diversifying the field lowers non-target damage and resistance.

question_text: A sample of size 16 has mean 52. H0: mu = 50 and sigma = 8 is known. What is the test statistic z?
explanation: z = (52 - 50) / (8 / sqrt(16)) = 2 / (8 / 4) = 2 / 2 = 1. The standard error uses sqrt(16) = 4, not 16.

question_text: Describe how the rate of reaction between magnesium and hydrochloric acid could be followed.
options: Measure the volume of hydrogen collected against time, or the loss in mass of the flask, and plot a graph
explanation: Both gas volume and mass loss give a quantity that changes measurably with time.

question_text: Which statement about electric potential and field strength is correct?
options: Electric potential is a vector quantity in the direction of the field
Potential is greatest where the field is weakest
Field strength is the negative potential gradient, E = −dV/dr
A charge's potential energy is independent of the potential
explanation: Field strength is the negative gradient of potential with respect to distance. Potential is a scalar, and a steep potential gradient corresponds to a strong field.

question_text: A monitoring-only system differs from control because it:
options: takes no action on the environment
explanation: B1: monitoring only measures/logs; control also acts on the environment via actuators

question_text: Why is the human circulatory system called closed?
options: It is open to the air
Blood stays inside vessels and the heart throughout the circuit
explanation: In a closed system blood is always contained, which maintains pressure and directs flow.

question_text: Where do the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis take place?
explanation: The light-dependent reactions happen on the thylakoid membranes of the chloroplast.

question_text: A celery stick is placed in coloured water and left in the light. Explain how the colour rises up the stem.
options: Water evaporates from the leaves, creating tension that pulls water up the xylem in a continuous column, and water molecules also move between xylem cells
The stem expands and pushes water up
Osmosis moves water upward through the walls
explanation: Transpiration from the leaves lowers pressure in the xylem, and cohesion between water molecules plus adhesion to the walls draws a continuous column upward.

question_text: How many cm³ are in 3 m³?
explanation: \(3 \times 100^3 = 3{,}000{,}000\). The others apply length, area, or partial factors to a volume.

question_text: 'The report ___ by the team every month.'
explanation: The report receives the action, so the passive present simple ('is written') is correct.

question_text: Which equation is parallel to y = 2x + 1?
explanation: Parallel lines have the same gradient. Both have m = 2.

question_text: The gap between two neurones is called a
explanation: A neurotransmitter diffuses across the synapse to carry the impulse to the next neurone.

question_text: An NTC thermistor's resistance:
explanation: An NTC (negative temperature coefficient) thermistor has resistance that falls as temperature rises. More thermal energy frees more charge carriers, so it conducts better.

question_text: What is the function of bile in digestion?
options: Emulsifies fats into small droplets, increasing the surface area for lipase, and neutralises stomach acid
explanation: Bile is not an enzyme: it physically disperses fat and raises the pH so pancreatic enzymes can work.

question_text: An endothermic reaction is one that
options: Absorbs heat from the surroundings, so the temperature falls
explanation: Endothermic reactions take in energy, cooling the surroundings; thermal decomposition is the standard example.

question_text: What happens during a heartbeat?
options: The atria contract, then the ventricles contract, forcing blood out
Blood flows continuously in one direction
explanation: Atrial contraction fills the ventricles, then ventricular contraction pushes blood into the arteries.

question_text: What is a ligand?
options: A species donating a lone pair to a central metal ion
explanation: Ligands (H2O, NH3, CN-, Cl-) coordinate to the metal via a lone pair, forming a complex ion.

question_text: Friedel–Crafts alkylation of benzene with CH₃Cl and AlCl₃ forms:
explanation: An alkyl group is attached to the ring, giving methylbenzene.

question_text: What is the electron configuration of a neutral oxygen atom (atomic number 8)?
explanation: Oxygen has atomic number 8, so eight electrons fill 1s² 2s² 2p⁴. The first shell takes two electrons and the second shell's 2s takes two more, with the remaining four in 2p. The second shell has no 2d subshell.

question_text: Why do root hair cells absorb mineral ions by active transport rather than diffusion?
options: Active transport is faster for all substances
Mineral ions are often in lower concentration in the soil than in the root, so they must be pumped against the gradient
Diffusion does not work in water
explanation: Because the soil solution is more dilute than the cell sap for many ions, the cell must use ATP and carrier proteins to take them in.

question_text: Explain how sacrificial protection works, using zinc on steel.
options: Zinc is more reactive than iron, so it is oxidised in preference, protecting the iron even where the coating is broken
explanation: The more reactive metal corrodes first, so the structural metal survives.

question_text: Find the midpoint of (2, 4) and (6, 10).
explanation: \(\left(\frac{2+6}{2}, \frac{4+10}{2}\right) = (4, 7)\). (8, 14) adds without halving; the others mis-average one coordinate.

question_text: A plant growing on a windowsill bends towards the light. Name the characteristic of living organisms shown and explain why it is not the same as the movement of an animal.
options: Growth only, with no response to the environment
Sensitivity: a directional growth response to a stimulus, not locomotion of the whole organism from place to place
explanation: The response is sensitivity (a tropism) produced by unequal growth; the plant does not move its whole body from one place to another as an animal does.
\(10^6\) outranks every \(10^5\) regardless of mantissa. Among the \(10^5\) pair, 4 beats 3.1 — but neither touches millions.

question_text: Explain why bond energies can be used to calculate ΔH but not to predict the rate.
options: They predict rate but not ΔH
They give the energy balance of the reaction, but the rate depends on activation energy and collision frequency
explanation: Thermodynamics and kinetics are separate: ΔH says whether energy is released, activation energy says how fast.

question_text: A wire is stretched beyond its elastic limit. Which statement about its force–extension graph is correct?
options: Extension is directly proportional to force
The graph is a straight line through the origin
The wire does not return to its original length when the force is removed
explanation: In the plastic region the graph is no longer a straight line, and the material is permanently deformed. The extension is not directly proportional to force there, so the other options are wrong.

question_text: A current of 0.50 A flows for 120 s. What charge passes a point in the circuit?
explanation: Charge is Q = It = 0.50 A × 120 s = 60 C. The current is measured in amperes, so multiplying by time gives coulombs.

question_text: Why is excess base filtered off in salt preparation?
options: So only the salt and water remain, preventing the base contaminating the crystals
explanation: The excess guarantees all the acid reacted, and it is insoluble so it can be removed.

question_text: Which act protects original software and writing from unauthorised copying?
explanation: Copyright protects original expression including code [1]. The Computer Misuse Act covers unauthorised access, and Data Protection covers personal data: different offences [1].

question_text: Which cells does HIV attack and why is this serious?
options: T helper cells, crippling the adaptive immune response
explanation: HIV infects CD4+ T helper cells, so both antibody production and cell-mediated immunity collapse (AIDS).

question_text: What is ⅔ ÷ ⅖?
explanation: Dividing by a fraction is the same as multiplying by its reciprocal: ⅔ ÷ ⅖ = ⅔ × 5/2 = 10/6 = 5/3.

question_text: Two identical springs in parallel (each k) give:
explanation: Both springs undergo the same extension x, while their restoring forces add: F=kx+kx=2kx. Thus the equivalent stiffness is 2k.

question_text: What is the oxidation state of sulfur in H2SO4?
explanation: Hydrogen is +1 (two atoms), oxygen −2 (four atoms), so S is +6.

question_text: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse 13 cm and one shorter side 5 cm. Find the smallest angle, to 1 decimal place.
explanation: sin(angle) = opposite / hypotenuse = 5/13 [1]. Angle = sin inverse (5/13) = 22.6 degrees to 1 d.p. [1]. Using 5 as the adjacent side (cosine) finds the other acute angle instead.

question_text: How is the entropy change of the surroundings related to the enthalpy change?
explanation: An exothermic reaction heats the surroundings, raising their entropy: dS(surr) = -dH/T.

question_text: At a junction in a circuit, 2.0 A flows in and 1.2 A flows out through one branch. What is the current in the other outgoing branch?
explanation: Kirchhoff's first law: current in = current out. So 2.0 = 1.2 + I, giving I = 0.8 A.

question_text: Why can antibiotics become ineffective over time?
options: Bacteria with resistant mutations survive and multiply, so the population becomes resistant
They are destroyed by stomach acid
explanation: Selection favours resistant bacteria, especially when courses are incomplete or antibiotics are overused.

question_text: The normal reaction acts:
explanation: The normal reaction is the contact force exerted by a surface and acts at right angles to it. It is not necessarily opposite to weight.

question_text: Explain why the elements are arranged by proton number rather than by relative atomic mass.
options: Proton number fixes the electron arrangement, so ordering by it places elements with the same outer-shell pattern in the same group
Proton number always equals mass number
explanation: Ordering by mass put some elements in the wrong group, which proton number corrected.

question_text: What is the purpose of the CLOSEFILE statement?
explanation: The CLOSEFILE statement releases system resources, options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrect as they describe other functions.

question_text: A street light switches on at dusk. Which sensor and pattern?
options: Light sensor whose reading falls below a threshold
Temperature sensor detecting the cold night
A timer with no sensor at all
explanation: Dusk is falling light: a light sensor reading below the threshold switches the lamp on. Motion, temperature and timers react to the wrong quantity or none.

question_text: Why does magnesium oxide have a much higher melting point than sodium chloride?
options: Its ions carry greater charges (2+ and 2-) so the lattice is stronger
explanation: MgO has 2+/2- charges against NaCl's 1+/1-, so the electrostatic attraction in the giant ionic lattice is much stronger.

question_text: The bond linking amino acids in a polypeptide is:
explanation: A condensation reaction forms a peptide bond between amino acids.

question_text: The unit of acceleration is
explanation: Acceleration is the change in velocity per second, so the unit is metres per second squared.

question_text: An AP has a = 5, d = 2. Find S_10.
Catalase breaks hydrogen peroxide into
explanation: 2H2O2 -> 2H2O + O2; the oxygen bubbles can be counted to measure the rate.

question_text: A car travels at 72 km/h. In metres per second this is
explanation: Multiply by 1000 and divide by 3600: 72 km/h = 72 x 1000 / 3600 = 20 m/s. [M1][A1]

question_text: What is the bonding in ethene?
options: One sigma and one pi bond between the carbons
explanation: The C=C double bond consists of one sigma bond (end-on overlap) and one pi bond (sideways overlap of p orbitals).

question_text: A cell is 0.05 mm long. On a drawing it measures 25 mm. What is the magnification?
explanation: Magnification = image size / actual size = 25 mm / 0.05 mm = 500.

question_text: Low-level code runs a motor controller. Why is assembly justified despite poor readability?
options: Direct hardware control with minimal overhead suits timing-critical control
explanation: Assembly touches registers and timing directly with no runtime overhead [1]. Motor control needs exact timing that high-level abstraction would blur [1]. Portability and readability are sacrificed knowingly.

question_text: Which evidence supports the delocalised model of benzene?
options: All C-C bond lengths are equal at 0.139 nm
It has three C=C bonds exactly
explanation: Equal bond lengths between single and double values show the pi electrons are delocalised around the ring.

question_text: Which information should usually be left out of a summary?
options: Examples and anecdotes that illustrate a point but are not required
Main points that answer the question
Key facts and figures the question asks for
Causes and effects the question names
explanation: Illustrations take up words without adding a required point. The other options all answer the question.

question_text: Which measure is most affected by outliers?
explanation: The mean is most affected by outliers because it uses every value in its calculation.

question_text: Simplify (3x)².
explanation: Raise each factor to the power 2: (3x)² = 3² × x² = 9x². The 3x² option squares only the x and leaves the 3 unsquared.

question_text: Explain the meaning of a 5% significance level in terms of Type I error.
options: 5% of H0 rejections are wrong on average when H0 is true
explanation: Significance 5% caps P(reject H0 | H0 true) at 0.05 [1]. Even a true H0 is wrongly rejected about 1 time in 20 [1]. It is not the probability H0 is true.

question_text: Record locking prevents:
explanation: Record locking stops two transactions from changing the same record at the same time. Without it, one update can overwrite another and leave the data inconsistent.

question_text: E(x̄) for any population with mean μ is:
explanation: The expected value of the sample mean equals the population mean μ, so the sample mean is an unbiased estimator of μ. The σ²/n option is the variance of the sample mean, a different quantity.

question_text: Which combination proves congruence of two right-angled triangles?
explanation: RHS (Right angle, Hypotenuse, Side) is a valid congruence condition for right-angled triangles.

question_text: Why do antibiotics not destroy viruses?
options: Viruses have no metabolism or ribosomes of their own
Viruses have a thick cell wall
explanation: Viruses use host cell machinery and lack the bacterial structures antibiotics target.

question_text: What is emotive language?
options: Words chosen to stir feelings (betrayal, innocent, ruin)
explanation: Emotive diction rallies sympathy or outrage in persuasive writing.

question_text: Explain why boiling a potato before adding hydrogen peroxide stops the reaction.
options: Boiling denatures the catalase, so the active sites are destroyed and hydrogen peroxide is not broken down
explanation: Catalase is a protein; heat destroys its tertiary structure, so no enzyme-substrate complexes can form.

question_text: What does Kp use in its expression?
explanation: Kp is written in terms of the partial pressures of the gases at equilibrium.

question_text: A lamp is supplied with 500 J and gives out 150 J of useful light. Its efficiency is
explanation: Efficiency = 150 / 500 x 100 = 30%. [M1][A1] The remaining 70% is wasted as heat.

question_text: Find the mean of 4, 7, 9, 10.
explanation: Mean = sum ÷ number of values = (4 + 7 + 9 + 10) ÷ 4 = 30 ÷ 4 = 7.5. The median of the same four numbers is 8, which is a different average and is not the answer here.

question_text: Why is phenylamine (aniline) a weaker base than ethylamine?
options: Its lone pair is delocalised into the benzene ring
explanation: The lone pair on N overlaps with the pi system, so it accepts protons less readily than alkyl amines.

question_text: The digital divide refers to:
options: Unequal access to technology between groups
explanation: Some people/regions have much less access to technology and internet.
Expand the brackets: (2 + 3i)(1 − i) = 2 − 2i + 3i − 3i². Collect the terms and use i² = −1 to get 2 + i + 3 = 5 + i.

question_text: Explain why a pulse can be felt at the wrist.
options: Each ventricular contraction pushes a wave of pressure into the arteries, which stretches their elastic walls and can be felt as a pulse
explanation: Arterial walls expand with each surge of blood, producing the pulse you feel where an artery is near the surface.

question_text: Solve 7 − 2x ≥ 1
explanation: Subtract 7 from both sides: −2x ≥ −6. Divide by −2 and reverse the inequality sign: x ≤ 3. Check: x = 3 gives 7 − 6 = 1, which satisfies ≥ 1.

question_text: A uniform beam of weight 100 N rests horizontally on two supports, one at each end. What is the reaction force at each support?
explanation: The beam is in equilibrium, so the two upward reactions total 100 N. The beam is uniform and symmetrical, so the weight acts at its centre and the reactions are equal: 50 N each.

question_text: Data is mirrored nightly with checksums and access levels. Which integrity threats do these counter?
options: Checksums catch corruption; mirroring survives disk loss; levels block unauthorised edits
explanation: Checksums detect corruption in transit/storage [1]. Mirrors plus access control cover loss and malicious edits together [1]. Each control answers a different threat class.

question_text: Which species is the radical that propagates the chain in chlorination of methane?
explanation: CH3• reacts with Cl2 to form CH3Cl and a new Cl• radical.

question_text: In uniform circular motion, the centripetal acceleration points:
explanation: Centripetal means 'centre-seeking': the acceleration is perpendicular to the velocity, towards the centre of the circle.

question_text: Explain why the active site is described as complementary rather than identical to the substrate.
options: It has exactly the same shape
It has a shape that fits the substrate closely, like a lock and key, so only that substrate binds
It is larger than the substrate
explanation: Complementary means the two shapes match where they meet, which produces specificity without being the same molecule.

question_text: In humans, the sex chromosomes of a male are
explanation: A male has one X and one Y; a female has two X chromosomes.

question_text: A rhetorical question is used to:
options: Make the reader consider a point, often assuming the answer
Start a new paragraph in a list
explanation: A rhetorical question is a persuasive device. It invites the reader to agree with the answer the writer expects.

question_text: Why is carbon dioxide described as an excretory product?
options: It is stored in the liver
It is breathed out with water
It is produced by respiration in every cell and is toxic in excess, so it must be removed via the lungs
explanation: Excretion means removing metabolic waste, and carbon dioxide is a waste product of aerobic respiration.

question_text: Antibiotics are drugs that
explanation: Antibiotics target bacterial structures such as cell walls, so they do not work on viruses.

question_text: Evaporation occurs:
explanation: Evaporation happens at any temperature from the surface of a liquid as the fastest molecules escape — no boiling required.

question_text: A walkie-talkie conversation uses over to hand over speaking turns. What mode is this?
explanation: Both sides send, but one at a time with turns — half-duplex. Simplex allows no reply; full-duplex needs no turns; serial is a wiring method, not a direction mode.

question_text: A school PC is used by 200 students. Which two OS features keep work private and the machine stable?
options: User accounts with passwords plus memory protection between programs
A bigger monitor and louder speakers
explanation: Marks as awarded: accounts with authentication give each student private storage [1]; protected memory stops one student's program crashing another's [1]. Decoration, entertainment and peripherals solve neither privacy nor stability.

question_text: To prove by contradiction that 'there is no smallest positive rational number', the assumption to make is:
options: Assume a smallest positive rational r exists, then r/2 is a smaller positive rational
explanation: Assume the smallest positive rational r exists. Then r/2 is positive, rational and smaller than r, contradicting minimality. Hence no smallest positive rational exists.

question_text: What type of compression is used for images and audio files?
explanation: Images and audio files often use lossy compression to reduce file size while preserving acceptable quality.

question_text: The energy released in respiration is used for
options: Muscle contraction, growth, active transport and keeping warm
explanation: ATP powers every energy-requiring process in the cell.

question_text: Write a pseudocode program to calculate the average of a set of numbers stored in an array. The array is called 'numbers' and has 10 elements.
options: FOR i = 1 TO 10: sum = sum + numbers[i]: average = sum / 10
FOR i = 1 TO 10: sum = sum + numbers[i]: average = sum / 11
FOR i = 0 TO 9: sum = sum + numbers[i]: average = sum / 10
FOR i = 0 TO 9: sum = sum + numbers[i]: average = sum / 11
explanation: The correct option uses the correct indexing and division, options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrect as they use incorrect indexing or division.

question_text: In a Karnaugh map, which cells may be grouped as adjacent?
options: Gray-code labels differing in one bit, including opposite-edge neighbours
Only cells in the same row
explanation: K-map adjacency means input combinations differ in exactly one variable. Gray-code ordering makes this visible; opposite edges wrap, but diagonal cells are not adjacent. Group sizes are powers of two.

question_text: A climber of mass 60 kg ascends 300 m in 15 minutes. Calculate the average useful power.
options: About 200 W: work done = 60 x 10 x 300 = 180,000 J, and 15 minutes is 900 s, so power = 180,000 / 900
explanation: Work done = mgh = 180,000 J. [M1] Time = 900 s, so P = 180,000 / 900 = 200 W. [M1][A1] Examiner warning: forgetting to convert minutes to seconds makes the answer 60 times too small.

question_text: A hash of a download is published. How does a user verify integrity, and what does a mismatch mean?
options: Re-hash and compare; mismatch means corruption or tampering
explanation: Recompute the hash locally and compare with the published value [1]. Any mismatch means alteration in transit or at source: do not trust it [1]. Hashes detect change; they do not prove who made it.

question_text: How many rows in a truth table for 3 inputs?
explanation: Each of the 3 binary inputs has 2 possible values, giving 2×2×2=2³=8 input combinations and therefore 8 truth-table rows.

question_text: What defines dynamic equilibrium?
options: Forward and reverse rates are equal while concentrations stay constant
explanation: Reactions continue in both directions at equal rates, so macroscopic properties no longer change.

question_text: A skydiver at terminal velocity has:
explanation: At terminal velocity the speed is constant, so acceleration and resultant force are zero. Upward drag therefore balances the downward weight.

question_text: Which is the correct reading of a reaction profile with a high hump?
options: The activation energy is large, so the reaction is slow unless heated
explanation: A tall hump means few collisions at room temperature can supply enough energy.

question_text: An acid is a substance that
options: Produces hydrogen ions, H+, in aqueous solution
explanation: All acid behaviour in this course follows from releasing H+ ions in water.

question_text: Find the mean of 4, 7, 9, 12 and 13.
explanation: Total = 4 + 7 + 9 + 12 + 13 = 45 [1]. Mean = 45 / 5 = 9 [1]. Answering 45 forgets the final division.

question_text: A function that returns a value uses the keyword:
explanation: The return statement sends a value back from a function to the code that called it. print displays output without sending a value back, and yield is used in generators.

question_text: Solve sin x = 1/2 for 0 <= x <= 2 pi.
explanation: sin x = 1/2 has solutions x = pi/6 and x = pi - pi/6 = 5pi/6 in this range.

question_text: Which loop type tests the condition AFTER executing?
explanation: A REPEAT ... UNTIL loop runs its body first and tests the condition at the end, so it always runs at least once. A WHILE loop tests before each iteration, so it may not run at all.

question_text: Which cell engulfs pathogens by phagocytosis?
explanation: Phagocytes such as neutrophils and macrophages engulf and digest pathogens.

question_text: What is irony?
options: A contrast between expectation and reality, or saying the opposite of what is meant
explanation: 'What lovely weather' during a storm is verbal irony; situational irony is an unexpected outcome.

question_text: A rectangle measures 12.4 cm by 7.6 cm, both to 1 d.p. Find the maximum possible area.
explanation: Marks as awarded: upper bounds 12.45 and 7.65 identified [1]; multiplied to 95.2425 [1]. 94.24 ignores bounds; 93.2425 is the minimum; 95.25 rounds an edge prematurely.

question_text: What causes the phases of the Moon?
options: The changing position of the Moon relative to the Sun and Earth
The Moon passing in front of the Sun only
explanation: The phases depend on how much of the sunlit side of the Moon we can see from Earth as it orbits.

question_text: ADH increases water reabsorption by:
options: making the collecting duct more permeable to water
explanation: ADH makes the collecting duct more permeable, so water leaves by osmosis.

question_text: What is a mood?
explanation: Mood (eerie, joyful, oppressive) is built from diction, imagery and rhythm.

question_text: Which SQL keyword sorts results?
explanation: ORDER BY sorts results (ASC = ascending, DESC = descending).

question_text: Malus' law is:
explanation: B1: Malus: I = I₀cos²θ for polarised light through an analyser at angle θ

question_text: A query must list products costing over 100, sorted high to low. Which SQL is correct?
options: SELECT Product, Price FROM Stock WHERE Price > 100;
SELECT Product, Price FROM Stock WHERE Price > 100 ORDER BY Price DESC;
explanation: WHERE filters above 100 [1]. ORDER BY Price DESC sorts high to low [1]. ASC would reverse the order and SORT is not SQL.

question_text: Which heading best fits a paragraph about reducing plastic use at home?
explanation: The heading must summarise the paragraph's main idea — home-level action against plastic.

question_text: Planets in solar system:
explanation: There are 8 planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.

question_text: A 5.0 kg mass is raised vertically through 4.0 m. What is the increase in its gravitational potential energy? Take g = 9.81 m s⁻².
explanation: Raising the mass vertically through 4.0 m gives ΔEp = mgΔh = 5.0 × 9.81 × 4.0 ≈ 196 J. Gravitational potential energy depends only on mass, g and the vertical height gained, so the 4.0 m height is used in full.

question_text: A pyramid of biomass is based on
options: The mass of living material at each trophic level
explanation: Biomass pyramids avoid the anomaly of one tree supporting many insects.

question_text: The string operation CONCATENATE:
explanation: CONCATENATE joins strings: "Hello" + "World" = "HelloWorld".
E(X) = Σ x·P(x) = 0 × 0.2 + 1 × 0.5 + 2 × 0.3 = 0 + 0.5 + 0.6 = 1.1. The 0.6 option is only the last term and leaves out the middle one.

question_text: What happens to the pressure in the thorax during inhalation?
options: It falls below atmospheric pressure, so air moves in
explanation: Increasing the volume lowers the pressure, and air flows in from the higher-pressure outside.

question_text: An organism has cell walls, no chlorophyll and feeds by absorbing nutrients from dead material. Which kingdom is it in?
explanation: Fungi are saprophytic heterotrophs with chitinous cell walls; they digest externally and absorb the products.

question_text: Why does the concentration of copper sulfate stay constant with copper electrodes?
options: Copper dissolves at the anode at the same rate as it is deposited at the cathode
explanation: The two processes balance, so the solution's composition is unchanged.

question_text: Where does transcription take place in a eukaryotic cell?
explanation: Transcription, making mRNA from a DNA template, happens in the nucleus of a eukaryotic cell. The mRNA then leaves through the nuclear pores to the cytoplasm, where translation takes place at ribosomes.

question_text: If the line of best fit passes through (20, 50) and (40, 90), what weight is estimated for x = 30?
Which statement about fermentation in yeast is correct?
options: It produces ethanol and carbon dioxide and is used in bread making and brewing
explanation: The carbon dioxide raises bread and the ethanol is the alcohol in beer and wine.

question_text: What is a vulnerability in the context of cyber security?
options: A threat that exploits a weakness
A weakness that an attack can use
explanation: A vulnerability is a weakness that an attack can use, while a threat is what exploits the vulnerability, and malware and cyber attacks are different concepts.

question_text: A car accelerates from rest to 30 m/s in 6.0 s. Its acceleration is
Energy of 4200 J raises the temperature of 1 kg of water by 1 K. What is the specific heat capacity?
explanation: Specific heat capacity c = Q/(mΔT) = 4200 J ÷ (1 kg × 1 K) = 4200 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹. This is the known value for water, about 4200 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹.

question_text: A database query uses the INNER JOIN clause to combine two tables, Orders and Customers. What is the result of this query?
options: A table with only the matching records from both tables
A table with all records from the Orders table and no records from the Customers table
A table with all records from the Customers table and no records from the Orders table
A table with all records from both tables
explanation: The INNER JOIN clause returns a table with only the matching records from both tables, where the join condition is met.

question_text: A motor does 600 J of work in 20 s. What is its power output?
explanation: Power = work done ÷ time = 600 J ÷ 20 s = 30 W. Power is the rate of energy transfer, so dividing by time gives watts.

question_text: Centripetal acceleration points:
explanation: Centripetal acceleration is always directed toward the centre of the circle. It changes the direction of the velocity without changing its speed.

question_text: Divide 600 dollars between Ama and Ben in the ratio 2 : 3. How much does each receive?
explanation: Total parts = 5, so one part = 600 / 5 = 120 [1]. Ama gets 2 x 120 = 240 and Ben 3 x 120 = 360 dollars [1]. Dividing by 2 and 3 directly (300/200 splits) ignores part values.

Multiplying two negative numbers gives a positive result: (−4) × (−6) = +24. The magnitudes multiply to 4 × 6 = 24 and the two negative signs combine to positive. The −24 option keeps a single negative sign.

question_text: Copper is used in electrical wiring because
options: It is a very good conductor and is ductile
explanation: Conductivity plus the ability to be drawn into wire.

question_text: Which gland secretes adrenaline?
explanation: Adrenaline from the adrenal glands prepares the body for action by raising heart rate and blood glucose.

question_text: Calls arrive at 4 per hour. The expected calls in 30 minutes is:
explanation: For calls arriving at a constant rate the expected count scales with the time interval. Over 30 minutes (0.5 hours) the expected count is 4 × 0.5 = 2. The 8 option is the count for two hours.

question_text: The region of an enzyme where the substrate binds is called the
explanation: The active site has a shape complementary to its substrate, which explains specificity.

question_text: Why is the C–X bond polar in a halogenoalkane?
options: Halogens are less electronegative than carbon
The halogen is more electronegative and pulls electrons towards itself
explanation: The halogen attracts the bonding electrons more strongly, leaving the carbon slightly positive.

question_text: Two sources are coherent when they have:
explanation: Coherent sources keep a constant phase difference, so their waves interfere steadily. Equal amplitude or intensity helps but is not what makes sources coherent.

question_text: Prove that the sum of two consecutive positive integers is always odd. Which argument is valid?
options: Let the integers be n and n + 2, giving 2n + 2, which is even
Let the integers be n and n + 1, giving 2n + 1, which is odd by definition
Test n = 1, 2, 3 and observe the sums are 3, 5, 7
Write the sum as 2n + 1 and note that 2n is odd
explanation: Let the consecutive integers be n and n + 1. Their sum is 2n + 1, which fits the definition of an odd number for every integer n, so the proof is complete and general. Testing cases is not a proof.

question_text: What is the nth term of the sequence 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, ...?
explanation: Common difference = 4. b = 3 − 4 = −1. nth term = 4n − 1.

question_text: Why does graphite conduct electricity?
options: Each carbon has one delocalised electron
explanation: Each carbon bonds to three others, leaving one electron per atom free to move between layers.

question_text: Φ(−z) equals:
explanation: The standard normal curve is symmetric about 0, so the area to the left of −z equals the area to the right of z. That area is 1 − Φ(z).

question_text: What is the value of C(7, 3)?
explanation: C(7, 3) = 7! / (3! x 4!) = (7 x 6 x 5) / (3 x 2 x 1) = 35. Dividing the ordered count 210 by 3! = 6 removes the order of the three chosen items.

question_text: A reflection in the line x = 0 maps (4, 7) to:
explanation: x = 0 is the y-axis. Reflection in y-axis: (x, y) → (−x, y). So (4, 7) → (−4, 7).

question_text: Increase 240 by 15%.
explanation: \(240 \times 1.15 = 276\). 255 adds 15 flat; 264 adds 10%; 204 decreases instead.

question_text: Find the coefficient of x^3 in the expansion of (1 + x)^(1/3).
A /26 IPv4 prefix leaves usable host addresses of:
explanation:
M1: /26 leaves 6 host bits → 2⁶ = 64 addresses
A1: minus network and broadcast = 62 usable hosts

question_text: Simplify \(\sqrt{50}\).
options: Leave it — it is already simplest
explanation: \(50 = 25 \times 2\), so \(5\sqrt{2}\). \(25\sqrt{2}\) squares the 5 back in wrongly; \(10\sqrt{2} = \sqrt{200}\); 25 is a square factor, so it simplifies.

question_text: Why does water have an anomalously high boiling point?
explanation: Each water molecule forms up to four hydrogen bonds, requiring extra energy to separate them.

question_text: For a data set, Q1 = 10 and Q3 = 22. Which value counts as an outlier?
explanation: IQR = 22 - 10 = 12, so the upper fence is Q3 + 1.5 x IQR = 22 + 18 = 40. Only 42 lies above 40.

question_text: A ramp rises 3 m over a horizontal distance of 4 m. What is the angle of inclination?
explanation: tan θ = opposite/adjacent = 3/4 = 0.75, so θ = tan⁻¹(0.75) ≈ 36.9°. Check with Pythagoras: the slope length is 5 m, and sin 36.9° = 0.6 = 3/5.

question_text: In the name Panthera leo, Panthera is the
explanation: The first word of a binomial name is the genus and is always capitalised; the second is the species.

question_text: Why is the human heart described as a double pump?
options: Its right side serves the lungs and its left side serves the body
explanation: The two sides pump to two separate circulations, which is why the walls differ in thickness.

question_text: |2x − 1| = 5 has solutions:
explanation: Split the modulus into two equations: 2x − 1 = 5 gives x = 3, and 2x − 1 = −5 gives x = −2. Both values satisfy the original equation.

question_text: Methyl orange in alkali is
explanation: Methyl orange is red in acid and yellow in alkali, with orange near neutral.

question_text: Which service translates a domain name such as example.com into an IP address?
explanation: The Domain Name System resolves names to IPs [1]. HTML structures pages, HTTP transfers them, FTP moves files: none resolve names [1].

question_text: For rotational equilibrium:
explanation: For zero resultant moment about a pivot, the sum of clockwise moments equals the sum of anticlockwise moments. Each moment is force × perpendicular distance.

question_text: Fusion requires:
explanation: Fusion needs a very high temperature (millions of °C) and pressure so that nuclei overcome their mutual repulsion and join.

question_text: Which of these needs continuous data?
explanation: Heights measure on a continuum. Colours and routes name; siblings count whole.

question_text: A car travels at a constant 12 m/s for 5 s. What distance is covered, and what does it equal on the graph?
explanation: Marks as awarded: rectangle area \(12 \times 5\) identified [1]; 60 m stated [1]. 30 halves (triangle error on constant speed); 17 adds the axes; 120 doubles.

question_text: Explain the greenhouse effect in three steps.
options: Sunlight heats the surface, the surface emits infrared radiation, and greenhouse gases absorb and re-emit it, warming the atmosphere
explanation: The sequence is incoming shortwave, outgoing infrared, and absorption and re-emission.
